commitments.heading: Daily commitments
commitments.guestNotice: Commitments are stored only in this browser. They are not synchronized across devices and can be lost if browser storage is cleared or you change devices.
commitments.emptyDescription: Nothing is scheduled for the selected date.

form.heading: New commitment
form.title: Title
form.typeHelp: Choose how this activity may be treated in planning.

validation.summary: Fix the highlighted fields before saving.
validation.titleTooLong: Title must be 120 characters or fewer
validation.descriptionTooLong: Description must be 500 characters or fewer
validation.invalidRange: End time must be later than start time
validation.crossMidnight: Commitments must end on the same day. Split this period into separate commitments.

overlap.heading: Time conflict
overlap.message: This commitment overlaps with other commitments on the same date.
overlap.details: Review the conflicts below, then acknowledge them to save.
overlap.acknowledgeHelp: Checking this box allows the overlapping commitment to be saved.

notices.storageUnavailable: Browser storage is unavailable. The commitment was not saved.
notices.storageQuota: Browser storage is full. The commitment was not saved.
notices.storageBlocked: Stored commitments could not be read safely. Saving is blocked to protect existing data.
notices.partial: Some stored commitments could not be restored.
notices.unsupported: Stored commitments use a newer version this app cannot read.
notices.corrupt: Stored commitments could not be read. Existing data was left untouched.
notices.migrationFailed: Older stored commitments could not be migrated. Existing data was left untouched.

unsaved.heading: Discard unsaved changes?
unsaved.description: Your entered values will be lost.

storageWarning.heading: Storage notice
storageWarning.description: Changes cannot be persisted right now.
